text:
Ana (People Ops): Heads up — Vik (new SWE) is starting next month but his H-1B needs an extension/transfer. We need to collect docs and kick off legal. Who can own coordination?
Kevin (Recruiter): I can own initial docs collection. I have his passport scan and current I-94. Still need recent paystubs and the signed offer.
Eli (Legal): Thanks. We'll need: passport bio page, current I-94, last 3 paystubs, signed offer letter (PDF), resume, and any previous approval notices. Also confirm his employer of record for payroll.
Maria (Hiring Manager): Payroll will be Redwood payroll. Kevin — can you confirm Vik has 3 recent paystubs? He was with a contractor before.
Kevin (Recruiter): He has 2 paystubs from contractor + 1 final from his previous employer. I'll ask him for bank statements if paystubs are thin. Also sending him the offer signature flow now.
Ana (People Ops): For timing: USCIS window is 45 days until his current status expiry. Legal needs full packet by EOD Monday to request premium. @Eli can you confirm timeline if we do premium processing?
Eli (Legal): If we file premium, we usually get adjudication in ~15 calendar days. Prep + internal approvals = 3 business days if docs are complete. If anything missing, that will push it.
Kevin (Recruiter): Noted. I'll create a secure upload link and tag this thread. Are we OK sharing passport/I-94 via the onboarding vault?
Ana (People Ops): Yes — use the onboarding vault link (private). Do NOT email scanned docs. Use the vault link or the encrypted S3 uploader.
Onboarding-bot: secure-upload://redwood-onboard/1719003456 - link expires in 7 days
Kevin (Recruiter): Upload link sent to Vik. He replied he can scan tonight. I'll confirm once everything's in the vault.
Eli (Legal): Once uploaded, I'll review and DM for missing items. Also flag any name-mismatch issues early (passport vs offer).
Ana (People Ops): Quick checklist for the thread so we don't lose items: 1) Signed offer (PDF) 2) Passport bio page 3) Current I-94 4) Last 3 paystubs / alternative proof 5) Resume 6) Employer/payroll confirmation. Kevin — add notes on source of paystubs.
Kevin (Recruiter): Will do. Ping me if legal needs anything extra. :thumbsup:
Ana (People Ops): Thanks team — looping back Monday AM with status.
